model.trollMix: one third always votes opposite the hidden truth; remaining trolls synchronize on destroyed during raids
model.note: Scenario assumptions are fixed before scoring; consensus parameters are unchanged. Results are simulations, not observed crowd measurements.

definitions.individualAccuracy: per honest voter's correct non-unsure votes / that voter's non-unsure votes; mean, median and 10th–90th percentiles across voter-run scores
definitions.falseDestroyedRate: validated destroyed on intact gold / all intact gold
definitions.falseIntactRate: validated intact on destroyed gold / all destroyed gold
definitions.votesPerTile: distinct final votes including unsure / all gold

headline: One viewer alone: 75.9%. Ten viewers including three trolls, weighted by hidden checks: 89.2% correct on the 81.3% of tiles they validated; the rest were refused and sent to experts.
